bible_verses.telugu: అయితే దేవుడు మనయెడల తన ప్రేమను వెల్లడిపరచుచున్నాడు; ఎట్లనగా మనమింకను పాపులమై యుండగానే క్రీస్తు మనకొరకు చనిపోయెను.
bible_verses.english: But God demonstrates his own love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.

bible_verses.telugu: అయితే మన ప్రభువైన యేసుక్రీస్తు సిలువయందు తప్ప మరి దేనియందును అతిశయించుట నాకు దూరమవును గాక; దానివలన నాకు లోకమును లోకమునకు నేనును సిలువవేయబడి
bible_verses.english: May I never boast except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.

bible_verses.telugu: మనము పాపముల విషయమై చనిపోయి, నీతివిషయమై జీవించునట్లు, ఆయన తానే తన శరీరమందు మన పాపములను మ్రానుమీద మోసి కొనెను. ఆయన పొందిన గాయములచేత మీరు స్వస్థత నొందితిరి.
bible_verses.english: "He himself bore our sins" in his body on the cross, so that we might die to sins and live for righteousness; "by his wounds you have been healed."

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for enduring the shame and pain of the cross for someone like me. I bring my heavy burdens to You today, trusting in Your endless pity and grace. Open the eyes of my heart so I can truly see the depth of Your love and sacrifice. May the joy of my salvation fill my soul and lead me to walk in faith every single day. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord Jesus, thank You for enduring the shame and pain of the cross for someone like me. I bring my heavy burdens to You today, trusting in Your endless pity and grace. Open the eyes of my heart so I can truly see the depth of Your love and sacrifice. May the joy of my salvation fill my soul and lead me to walk in faith every single day. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: Looking at the cross can be overwhelming when we realize the depth of Christ's sacrifice for us, yet it is also the very place where our true joy begins. When we bring our heavy burdens and sins to Jesus, His incredible grace rolls them away and opens our eyes to His love. The cross is not just a historical event; it is the moment our hearts find light, freedom, and lasting peace. Today, let us linger at the cross, worshiping the Savior who gave everything so we could live in His light.
